name: Acupuncture clinic
summary: How expats try acupuncture in Singapore — TCM vs medical acupuncture pathways, licensed practitioners, and what to expect for pain and stress visits.
body:
Acupuncture is offered through TCM clinics and some medical settings. Licensing and training paths differ — confirm who is treating you and whether needles are single-use. Common expat visits include neck/back tension, migraine adjunct care, and stress-related sleep issues.

## Decision points
- TCM acupuncture vs medical acupuncture framing
- Practitioner licensing and hygiene standards
- Course of sessions vs one-off trial
- Combination with physio / pain clinic care
- Insurance or corporate wellness coverage limits

Tell the practitioner about pregnancy, anticoagulants, and implants.

## How to choose
Prefer clinics that explain the treatment plan length and stop rules if there is no change. Ask about sterile disposable needles. Avoid guaranteed-cure marketing.

## Practical tip
Eat a light snack beforehand and schedule buffer time after the first session — some people feel briefly lightheaded.
